card.title: Lost and Found – Catch the Critters

metadata.author: Momma Bear Audio
metadata.description:
*Printable Map Included!Something strange happened at the wildlife rescue last night… eight burrowing critters have disappeared underground! A groundhog, chipmunk, rabbit, prairie dog, vole, gopher, mole, and mouse are hiding somewhere beneath a large grassy field, and the rescue team needs your help finding them.In this interactive Lost and Found adventure, kids become official Critter Catchers! Using the included field map, players choose which holes they want to investigate and turn to the matching audio chapters to search. Shine your flashlight into each tunnel, listen for signs of movement, and discover whether a missing critter is hiding inside.There’s no set order to the adventure, so every player can choose their own path through the field. Keep searching until all eight animals have been safely found and returned to the wildlife rescue.Printable map located in folder below.Run time: 33 min

Looking for other free audio sources, ideas and inspo? Maybe you want to submit a request for some sort of specific audio for your kids? Join my FB Group! I am always taking suggestions and working to get the audio your kids want.
